$note: Provenance record for the scoring tables the app ships. The tables are the OUTPUT of analysis/extract_scoring_tables.py, which parses the official PDF and asserts structural invariants (20 score levels in order, weights summing to exactly 100, strictly monotonic thresholds, gap-free BMI categories) and aborts rather than emit a table it cannot verify. No threshold is ever entered by hand. scripts/check-data.mjs asserts the sha256 below on every build; a mismatch means the file was edited outside the extractor.
